humanEvidence.origin: Project Gravicentra Insurance conversation, screenshots and observations on 2026-10-08 about 17:11–17:33 America/Guatemala

findings.observation: Normal signed-in Dirección browser could not load pipeline; terminal message says Aseguradoras not server-confirmed.
findings.demonstratedCause: Readiness requires polizas,clientes,aseguradoras together, while hydration contract defers optional collections; 8-second deadline terminates whole board.
openDiscriminants: same authenticated real role and fresh browser cold/warm
serverConfirmedCollections versus snapshotErrors and denied
policy+client authoritative readback
pipeline exact eligible IDs
assess retry reattachment and event rerender

findings.observation: Cartera label says no cartera loaded despite individual client showing 12 receipt obligations, open balance, payment records.
findings.demonstratedCause: List financially depends on deferred carteraPrimas and indexed summary; store event listener suppresses rerender when listWaitingForReady is false.
openDiscriminants: compare list and detail same client canonical IDs after server confirmed
check late async projection and effective overlays
confirm served payload bytes

findings.observation: Future installments displayed Pago registrado en SIGA with missing payment date; collected KPI and reconciliation status require physical proof.
findings.demonstratedCause: realizedPaymentRows() includes source-classified CRM_DIRECT receipts even without receiptHasAppliedPayment; origin alone cannot prove cash realization.
openDiscriminants: read exact client/policy/receipt IDs and payment evidence
reconcile report source versus source-authority marker
check dates and future installment statuses
preserve monetary values and physical source

findings.observation: Queue shows zero proposal rows despite payment/receipt screens containing pending-conciliation labels.
findings.demonstratedCause: Screen is proposal browser, not ledger of all paid/reconciled events; however it reports zero without confirmed hydration/proposal readback distinction.
openDiscriminants: server-confirmed rows for conciliaciones and conciliacionesPrimas
pending client receipt action linkage
historical reconciled payment listing versus proposal queue

findings.observation: Displays 0 interactions despite observed collaboration and business changes.
findings.demonstratedCause: Global module reads actividades only, does not include bitacora/audit domain events, nor assert confirmed hydration before zero.
openDiscriminants: verify actual actividades readback
recover approved cross-module audit surface without inventing historical actors/dates

findings.observation: Input loses focus during continuous typing.
findings.demonstratedCause: Input listener debounces a full render(host) which replaces the focused text input.
openDiscriminants: 20-character typing and selection/caret test on exact candidate

findings.observation: Confirmar origen del país routes to non-focal/general or phone-oriented modal.
findings.demonstratedCause: forceProvenance prepends pais to ordinary missing fields instead of restricting selection to geo/provenance; general Corregir datos applies focus=f[0], which becomes phone-only when first gap is telefono.
openDiscriminants: focus-specific country fields; phone/general distinct; valid persistence and audit

findings.observation: No clear way to change selected contact medium.
findings.demonstratedCause: The visible label is derived from telefono/whatsapp/email. The inline action exposes Add phone only when no phone; there is no separate contact-preference setting in this surface.
openDiscriminants: approved client editor contract and preferred contact medium, if any

findings.observation: Real-business Preview attachment upload fails even though Remove/Replace controls exist.
findings.demonstratedCause: File upload occurs before business commit; Preview restricts mutations of non-synthetic records, but exact failing call must be traced before determining backend fault.
openDiscriminants: safe persistent synthetic human-UAT fixture
upload/finalize/read/download/reload/cleanup
denial must name actual reason

findings.observation: Stage stepper too close to header and partially clipped; inner scroll is fragmented.
findings.demonstratedCause: Stepper is a horizontally scrollable strip inside vertically constrained modal with an independently scrolling body; needs measured layout proof.
openDiscriminants: 1440/390/320 bounding boxes and route actions reachability

findings.observation: Reason shown as Sin motivo registrado; user cannot find creation or edit action.
findings.demonstratedCause: Detail renders reason read-only and save patches recuperacion/notaRecuperacion only; policy-derived reason comes from motivoCancelacion/cancellationReason.
openDiscriminants: source of canonical cancel motive and approved write transport
no invented reason or bulk backfill

findings.observation: Previously requested information architecture and visual design have not materially changed.
openDiscriminants: source-backed catalog and document links
human visual design acceptance
operational directory/security remain P0
